description:
This is a breakdown of core-motivators that I've found exceptionally helpful in my coaching.

I've yet to meet anyone who doesn't prize one of these above any of the others--in other words, who wouldn't sacrifice the rest in favour of one. 

- Goodness/Rightness
- Identity/Significance
- Capability/Competence
- To be loved/To love
- Peace/Balance
- Control/Autonomy
- Stability/Certainty
- Worth/Value
- Experience/Enjoyment 

By understanding which of these you would choose above any other, we can start to get to the root of why you're doing what you're doing

to find NEW ways to get you where you want to go,

...without the cost that comes with the way you're doing things now.

It can let us create RELIABLE motivation, rather than having to depend on the threat of stress and deadlines to force yourself into action.

And you can comment 'R03' if you'd like a tool that will help you explore your own motivation a little more deeply
